description: Preview the cleanest run window before a task's deadline, without queuing it. Use when: the user asks when a task would run or what waiting saves. Do not use to queue the task (use schedule_task) or for the raw hourly curve (use get_grid_forecast). Behavior: writes nothing; reads the grid forecast; no login or key. Returns: scheduled_for, intensity, band, estimated_carbon_g_co2, estimated_savings_vs_now_pct, batch_eligible, grid_source (mock = synthetic), alternatives, reasoning; routing_preview with 2+ candidates. Rejects a past deadline, an unknown zone, or a carbon_budget_g no window meets.

candidates.description: 'provider:model' pairs the user allows, e.g. ['anthropic:claude-haiku-4-5','ollama:llama-3-1-8b']. With 2 or more, the scheduler scores each at the chosen window on carbon, cost and latency (see route_weights), runs the winner and records the scores on the receipt; it never picks a model outside this list. Omit, or pass one entry, to keep provider and model as given. A model missing from the price table is rejected.

carbon_budget_g.description: Hard cap on the task's estimated grams CO2e, e.g. 5. Windows above it are skipped; if no window before the deadline fits, the task fails instead of running on a dirty grid. Omit for no cap.

deadline.description: When the task must be finished: ISO-8601 with a UTC offset, in the future. Convert the user's words, e.g. "by 8am tomorrow" in New York becomes '2026-05-13T08:00:00-04:00'.

model.description: Model name to mention in the reasoning text, e.g. 'claude-sonnet-5'; it does not change the window. Omit to leave it out.

region.description: Grid zone the task would run against, e.g. 'US-CAL-CISO' or 'FR'. `tidegap region list` prints the supported zones; any zone works with an Electricity Maps key. Defaults, where the host lets it be omitted, to the configured region, else the stored setting (`tidegap region set`), else a time-zone guess, else GB.

route_weights.description: How to rank candidates, e.g. {"carbon": 1} for carbon only. Weights are relative and normalized; a key left out counts as 0. Omit for the default {carbon: 0.6, cost: 0.3, latency: 0.1}. Ignored unless candidates has 2 or more entries.

carbon.description: Relative weight on the estimated grams CO2e at the chosen window. Omit to weight it 0 when route_weights is given.

cost.description: Relative weight on the estimated USD list cost, batch discount included when eligible. Omit to weight it 0 when route_weights is given.

latency.description: Relative weight on speed: local beats hosted sync, which beats hosted batch. Omit to weight it 0 when route_weights is given.

name: recommend_window
